correctness.rationale: The unit-area normalized affine kernel has covariance q_n=(2+cos(2pi/n))/12 from barycentric triangle moments. Convexity and kernel sign disagreement make the vertices exactly norming. Shoelace cap integration proves the explicit norm and negativity defect. Exact rational interval certificates establish all n=3..11 signs and a strict disk upper majorant below one half for all n>=11. The analytic radial cell expansion and exact disk integrals give the coefficient 5 pi sqrt(15)/12; no sampled finite list is treated as a proof of the universal statement.

value.rationale: The natural constant 2 corresponds to one-half worst nonnegative-input positivity loss, a concrete stability threshold for local affine least-squares elements. Determining its exact 6/7 side crossover, every norming vertex, and the positive second-order polygon-to-disk coefficient adds nontrivial, parameter-uniform stability and asymptotic information not supplied by simple norm convergence or tabulations.
